The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-4|payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages, a free web hosting service provided by GitHub, is the foundation of a sovereign digital commerce stack that enables digital creators to host their online stores without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. By leveraging GitHub Pages, creators can maintain full control over their product distribution and payment processing, eliminating the need for intermediaries like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale. In contrast, NOWPayments, a key component of this stack, charges a mere 0.5% fee, retaining $921 annually for a creator selling 100 products per month at $97 each.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of this sovereign digital commerce stack is built on a combination of free and open-source tools, including GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway, handles automatic on-chain payment verification, enabling creators to receive payments directly from their customers without relying on traditional payment processors like Stripe or PayPal.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This sovereign digital commerce stack is designed for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, but are restricted from using Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or other traditional payment platforms. By providing a free and open-source solution, COREMERCH empowers creators to take control of their product distribution and payment processing, ensuring they retain 99.5% of their sales revenue and maintain full ownership of their digital products.

The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this sovereign digital commerce stack include GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway, integrates seamlessly with these components, enabling automatic on-chain payment verification and ensuring that creators receive payments directly from their customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

With these steps, creators can establish a fully functional sovereign digital commerce stack in a matter of hours.

To set up your GitHub Pages site, create a new repository on GitHub, upload your website files, and configure your GitHub Pages settings to point to the correct branch. This will enable you to host your digital products on a free and customizable platform.
